title: Building a Million-Dollar Sign Business from Scratch
description: Sarah Johnson shares her incredible journey from starting in her garage with $5,000 to running one of the midwest's most successful sign companies with 40 employees.
keyTakeaways: Start with one niche and dominate it before expanding
Reinvest 80% of profits in the first 3 years for exponential growth
Hiring the right people is more important than having the best equipment
Systems and processes are the foundation of scalable growth
Customer relationships are your most valuable asset
